scope: Ten hardcoded released Frame Bench choices, one-input removal callback, two shapeless recipes and 32 exact armor Infusion recipes. No game execution or complete acquisition census.
limits: FrameBenchRecipe is a display helper with a null serializer; these choices are menu-driven, not ten JSON recipes
One full armor-frame set needs four separate output takes and four Scrap Metal under the selected callback
Ingredient repetition counts units across four separate recipes; it does not mean stacked ingredients can share a slot or that bulk output is supported
Tags preserve active-pack substitution; no fixed vanilla-only member list is assumed
clickMenuButton has no explicit range guard before assigning the index in the inspected method; invalid-state handling remains a bounded acceptance task
The remaining armor registrations may use loot, code rewards, other mechanisms or have unresolved acquisition; this scan is not proof of absence
